title: o5s
description: Immutable patch collaboration with reviewed admission, conflict preservation, incremental graph summaries and checked text rendering.
author: Codex (agent-authored explanation; proof results are supplied by h5i-app check)
exclusions: Authentication, immutable-record hashing and registry facts are native application trust boundaries.
Graph equivalence requires the adjacency representation and summary invariants stated by its theorems.
Allocation failures, Rust UTF-8 decoding, filesystem/Git behavior and live Cloudflare services are outside the extracted proofs.
The complete causal file materializer and native interval index are tested, not universally proved.
Charon/Aeneas fidelity, Lean and the Rust compiler are trusted.
Local scaling fixtures do not establish distributed HTTP throughput.

nodes.title: Patch admission
nodes.description: Requires approval, passing checks and present dependencies; repeated delivery adds no second copy. Caller supplies authenticated registry facts.

nodes.title: Extracted admission agrees with guards
nodes.description: Refines the actual Rust decision under the stated vector-capacity precondition.

nodes.title: Successful admission order preserves membership
nodes.description: Two successfully admitted patches yield equal membership in either order; this does not choose a winner among conflicting edits.

nodes.title: Reusable indexed graph traversal
nodes.description: Queues each reached vertex once and clears only visited marks.

nodes.title: Indexed traversal computes reachability
nodes.description: Exact reachable membership, unique bounded queue and reusable clean marks under the theorem’s representation/capacity conditions.

nodes.title: Dead-interior boundary refinement
nodes.description: Actual indexed boundary output equals live endpoints of nonempty dead-interior walks under explicit row representation assumptions.

nodes.title: Live summary preserves reachability
nodes.description: An exact boundary summary preserves reachability between live endpoints, including cyclic graphs.

nodes.title: Checked byte rendering
nodes.description: Rejects invalid interval ordering, endpoints and conservative capacity overflow before copying original gaps and replacement bytes.

nodes.title: Checked renderer returns the specified bytes
nodes.description: Unconditional input validation/refusal and accepted rendering specification in the extracted semantics.

nodes.title: Line offsets are ordered and bounded
nodes.description: The actual LF scan equals its byte model with bounded strictly increasing positions under input length < Usize.max.

nodes.title: h5i-app Kernel adapter
nodes.description: Carries server-derived review/check/dependency facts to the extracted admission function.

nodes.title: Native conflict materialization
nodes.description: Immutable-base concurrent ranges use a tested neighbor index; whole-file causal heads retain explicit conflicting alternatives. The complete engine remains a tested boundary.

nodes.title: Authenticated local API
nodes.description: Tenant-scoped repositories, proposals, review/check reporting and atomic snapshot transactions.

nodes.title: Cloudflare edge adapter
nodes.description: Artifacts capabilities are scoped through authenticated origin responses; mock tests do not establish live account integration.
